body:
I can't reproduce the second part in 4.5.dev. It now silently fails because https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/99680.
By the way, the first example triggers an error too if you select the node in the "Remote" scene tree because it opens the remote inspector.

The error makes sense when you consider the context. The stack variables at the bottom dock and the remote inspector in the side dock work differently. The error comes from the remote inspector, which calls getters. If you make the first script a `@tool` and `e` a `@export` variable, the regular inspector will cause an invalid access error too when you select the node. On the other hand, the stack variable debugger displays the stack's memory (raw values) so it doesn't call getters.

The current behavior in master of failing silently seems like a bug while the previous behavior reported here is correct.
